subject: Demo recap & proposed evaluation journey — Sandstone AI
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@sandstone.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@sandstone.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 May 2028 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap & proposed evaluation journey — Sandstone AI

Hi Olivia / Rajiv,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation and a solid first pass at where Redwood can help Sandstone accelerate developer productivity while keeping costs predictable. Recap + proposed next steps below so we have a single plan to share with your team.

Quick recap (from today’s demo):
- Goal: Reduce model inference cost for conversational search and improve 95th pct latency from ~450ms to <200ms for the most common query paths.
- Success metrics you called out: average token cost reduction >= 35%, 95p latency <200ms, and parity on relevance for top-3 answers compared to current baseline.
- Integration surface: API-based generation + streaming for the UI, embeddings for semantic search, and a small rerank model we’ll host as a companion endpoint.

Proposed evaluation (POC) journey — lightweight 3-week sprint:
1) Week 0 (kickoff, 3 business days): alignment + access
   - Parties: Kimberly (Redwood AE), Rishi (SE), Olivia / Rajiv (Sandstone eng + product)
   - Deliverables: NDA signed / POA, sample dataset access (S3 link or sample CSV), security checklist initial exchange
2) Week 1 (baseline + quick wins): integration + smoke tests
   - Redwood provides prebuilt client snippet + recommended config for streaming and batching.
   - Run baseline on a 5k sample set to get cost/latency numbers.
3) Week 2 (optimize & validate): caching, quantization profile, and rerank tuning
   - Apply caching and prefix KV strategies, run experiments for 2 model variants; measure relevance drift.
4) Week 3 (wrap & decision): handover + success review
   - Consolidated report: cost/latency deltas, top failure modes, recommended next steps for production.

Ownership (proposed):
- Redwood: Kimberly (engagement lead), Rishi (technical lead) — will deliver runbook, test harness, SOC2 summary
- Sandstone: Olivia (product owner), Rajiv (lead engineer), Procurement (legal/PO)

What we need from Sandstone to start:
- Sample dataset extract (anonymized) or access instructions to a 5k query test set (test-data-spec.csv attached as an example)
- Point of contact for infra/keys and a procurement contact for a short SOW
- Confirmation the timeline above works, or if you prefer a stretched 5-week cadence for deeper integration.

Attachments: sandstone_poc_runbook_v1.pdf (POC checklist & timelines), test-data-spec.csv (schema + sample rows), redwood_soc2_summary.pdf (summary of artifacts we can share).

Next step I suggest: 30-minute kickoff on Tuesday 5/22 or Wednesday 5/23 to lock in access and owners. Olivia — which day works best for you?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@sandstone.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@sandstone.ai>, procurement@sandstone.ai
Date: Fri, 18 May 2028 17:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo recap & proposed evaluation journey — Sandstone AI

Kimberly — thanks for the succinct recap. This looks practical and aligned with what we discussed. A couple of quick questions before we lock the kickoff: 

1) For the baseline sample set — can we run against a subset of live traffic in a read-only fashion, or do you recommend synthetic? We prefer read-only if there are no privacy concerns.
2) For SOC2 artifacts — is the summary you attached sufficient for procurement to approve a PoC, or will they ask for the full report?
3) Pricing — do you have a ballpark for the expected usage during a 3-week run (tokens / infra) so procurement can pre-approve spend?

Rajiv is looping in procurement here to start that conversation. We can do Tuesday 5/22 at 10:30am PT for a 30-min kickoff — tentatively confirmed on our side.

– Olivia
Olivia Chen
Head of Product, Sandstone AI
olivia.chen@sandstone.ai | +1 212-555-0147

Hi Olivia — quick technical notes that should help procurement and your infra team: 

- Read-only live traffic: we can run the baseline against a read-only tap (sidecar) if you can provide a sanitized S3 bucket or a redacted stream. Our SDK supports streaming ingestion and will not persist any PII. If you prefer, synthetic sampling is also straightforward and faster to provision.
- Estimated cost for a 3-week run (approx): 40M tokens total across test runs -> Estimated spend ~$1,200 - $1,800 depending on batching and sequence length. I[0m
- Runbook notes: the attached sandstone_poc_runbook_v1.pdf includes concrete CI steps, curl snippets for the streaming client, and recommended batching settings. test-data-spec.csv shows the schema we typically use.
- Security: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf is a short-summary; if procurement requests the full report we can provide an on-demand secure viewing link (we do not share full reports over email).

I'll be on the kickoff with Kimberly; we can also bring a solutions engineer to sit with Rajiv for the first 90 minutes to pair on access.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
